    Facts that change the advice

    How to read the levels

    • Safe The owner program makes it again by itself. No user data.
    • Review Regenerable, but costs a download, a rebuild or some state, or a program uses it now.
    • Risky Can hold data that exists only here, or a tool depends on it.
    • Keep Information only. Use the owner app to manage it.
